slides.dek: This instructor has never paid retail. Or paid.

slides.body: Stores call it closing time. The raccoon calls it the night market. Legal has asked us to state clearly: do not do this.
Humans abandon 70% of their carts. The raccoon has never abandoned anything in its life. Commitment IS the discount.
The raccoon once traded a bottle cap for an entire sandwich. Yes, the other party was a child. A deal is a deal.

slides.h: SCARCITY IS AN INVENTION. INVENT HARDER.
slides.body: Limited edition means someone counted. The raccoon numbered 300 identical rocks and sold out. Twice. Same rocks.

slides.h: IF THE DEAL LOOKS TOO GOOD, IT'S HIS
slides.body: Found a designer lamp at 90% off? Congratulations. You are buying it from the raccoon. Check your garden. It is your lamp.
Send this to the friend with 14 open cart tabs.
